Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“What the void took, it didn’t replace. That’s the feature, not the bug.”

Qliph-Scarred (Husk). Mode: absence. The scar is hollow. Something was there and is not, and you are the space left over.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Qliph-Scarred).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Hollow Core. You resist psychic damage. Divination and emotion-reading effects against you fail on a d10 roll of 5 or lower (the GM rolls silently) — they return only the hollow echo.
  • No Weight Inside. You do not need to eat or drink. You sit outside the social thread during communal Soma Break ceremonies; the GM narrates what that costs (allies may be unsettled; benefits from shared-rest bonuses are denied).
  • Signature. You gain The Quiet Inside at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.
